simfiles.pulse_geometry_correction: Apply native Actor::PreDraw pulse zoom and RGB axis scaling to projected vertices, including parent frames and wrappers; normalize both scalar and table effect colors.
simfiles.pulse_clock_correction: Native bgm is a beat clock; music is the seconds clock.
simfiles.motion_geometry_correction: Apply native Actor::PreDraw Bob, Bounce and Wag poses before composing parent and wrapper matrices; use native macro timer resets and float timer advancement.
